title: Street bands and parade men
summary: Barnes names street bandsmen and says Buddy Petit and Chris Kelly were parade men, Buddy more so.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: Do they have any really ratty brass bands here? You know, that really played tunk music in the streets?
Well, yeah. All the same men that played jazz bands played the same music.
I'm talking about, say, in 1910 when you were just really coming out, who would be in the street playing really tunk music?
Well, we had a good men up in there. You had Joe Oliver Day, you had Manuel Perez, you had Kimmer, you had Icon White. Oh, I couldn't get you the names of all of them.
Yeah, but I mean, non-reading bands, ones that didn't read at all, wouldn't they have those?
Well, that's a pretty tough one. Most of them had something.
They had some guys that were doing.

They all had something. They wasn't professional. You see, you take a man in them time, if he was in, uh, 7th or 6th grade age, he wouldn't say anything about musicians. You understand? It's like a man, a priest or a preacher or something. You know that, you know, when you put yourself there, you put yourself up against something. I call it the same thing. You catch a man up in there, well, he, he take a piece of music and he sit down and he figure it out and he go on, he go on it and then he take it and he run it over it. Well, he fight that fight until he get it. When he get it, it might be something in there hard for him to memorize. See, well, when he get to playing it, then, what you gonna play? Oh, 27. He said, man, this darn thing is with me so much, man, I'm scared of it. He run over, he correct that part then and say, let's go. Well, that's actually correct, but if you take a man that's reading music, what you got, 27? You all ready? All right.
Did Chris have a brass band, Chris Kelly? No. He would never play a little jump up job or anything like that, huh?
No, he always hired him on that. Did he read? Yeah, spell.
What about Buddy? Did he get out in the street much? Buddy?

Oh, he was a parade man. Buddy was more parade man than what Kelly was. Kelly was a parade man too, but he wasn't like Buddy. The man, huh, Joe Olive. They say Walter Bloom, wasn't it? That man was invited parade, you see? He was a good man and more, I was calling the name, but I can't think of.
